A $300,000 Portfolio in Omega Healthcare, Edison International and Altria Pays $17,064 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
summary: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $300,000 portfolio split evenly across Omega Healthcare, Edison International and Altria pays about $17,100 a year in dividends at today’s prices, or about $1,420 a month. Omega is the least covered of the three, paying out 91% of its AFFO in fiscal 2025, though consensus has that easing to 86% in fiscal 2026.
